findings.summary: Download-count identity duplicates the library-summary identity helper.
findings.consequence: Two cache identities for the same filter-plus-advanced-filter concept can drift independently if the identity shape changes, leaving summary invalidation and download-count invalidation comparing different keys.
findings.evidence: Line 732 defines downloadCountIdentity as JSON.stringify([filterValue, advanced]), while the same file already defines librarySummaryIdentity with the same implementation for the same filter/advanced identity boundary.
findings.recommendation: Use the existing librarySummaryIdentity helper for downloadCounts as well, or rename it to a shared filterAdvancedIdentity helper and call that from both summary and download-count code.
